description: List conversations the calling user is a member of.

cursor.description: Paginate through collections by setting cursor to next_cursor.

exclude_archived.description: Set to true to exclude archived channels. Default: false.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (max: 999). Default: 100.

team_id.description: Encoded team id to list conversations in (required if org token is used).

types.description: Mix and match channel types: public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im. Default: public_channel.

user.description: Browse conversations by a specific user ID's membership.
